title: Wave 10: preset parts, status sets, lineage (tickets 25-29)
goal: Implement, review and merge tickets 25-29 of wave 10 on main: status sets per stock kind with transition rules and in-stock views (spec 4), lineage: true + tm lineage, molbio split into parts (molbio 2-to-3), cellbio and angenet bundles. Done when 25-29 are merged, the full suite is green, tm init works for molbio/cellbio/angenet/[molbio,cellbio] and each passes tm check.

tasks.title: 25 status sets, transition rules, in-stock views (spec 4)

blocks.title: implement ticket 25 in worktree w25
blocks.doc: Read docs/tickets/25-status-sets-transitions.md and docs/preset-parts.md section 4. Work only in the worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w25 (branch wave10/t25, own .venv). Real dolt, no mocks, no commit, leave the tree dirty. Do not touch real ledgers. Report what you chose wherever the ticket leaves a choice.
done_when: Every item of ticket 25 Verify passes: status-set load errors; tube stored->consumed allow, consumed->stored refuse, --force --note allow with forced=TRUE, --force without --note usage error; creation as consumed works; a hand-written illegal status event is FAIL in tm check; v_stock_<kind> active/depleted/empty and counts as specified; spec/3-to-4 on a spec-3 fixture drops the key, adds forced, tm check passes; custom list refuses writing nothing.

runs.note: Dispatched to teammate w25 in worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w25 (branch wave10/t25, from main 3831fb2).

blocks.title: review and merge ticket 25
blocks.doc: Lead: review the worktree diff against the ticket and the design doc, run the full suite in the worktree, check no real ledger was touched, then commit on wave10/t25 and merge into main with the wave 9 style merge commit. Record review findings as a note.
done_when: Diff reviewed line by line; full suite green in the worktree; no real ledger touched; branch committed and merged to main; plans/ updated.

tasks.title: 26 lineage true on ref fields + tm lineage

blocks.title: implement ticket 26 in worktree w26
blocks.doc: Read docs/tickets/26-tm-lineage.md and docs/preset-parts.md section 5. Work only in the worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w26 (branch wave10/t26, own .venv). Real dolt, no mocks, no commit, leave the tree dirty. Read whatever count columns v_stock_<kind> has through one small accessor so ticket 25 only changes the accessor. Record where the lineage flags were added.
done_when: Every item of ticket 26 Verify passes: construct->plasmid->bacterial stock->child stock->source aliquot chain and cell_line parental line show in tm lineage; --up/--down/--depth trim; diamond prints see-above once and JSON lists the node once; --format dot parses with dot -Tsvg if installed; lineage: true on a string field fails to load; no SPEC_VERSION bump.

runs.note: Dispatched to teammate w26 in worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w26 (branch wave10/t26, from main 3831fb2).

blocks.title: review and merge ticket 26
blocks.doc: Lead: review the worktree diff against the ticket and design, run the full suite, check the lineage accessor is the single place that reads stock counts, then commit on wave10/t26 and merge into main. Record findings as a note.
done_when: Diff reviewed; full suite green; accessor is the only count reader; no real ledger touched; branch committed and merged to main.

blocks.title: implement ticket 27 in worktree w27
blocks.doc: Read docs/tickets/27-molbio-into-parts.md and docs/preset-parts.md section 2. Work only in the worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w27 (branch wave10/t27, own .venv). Decide and record: which part includes which for plasmid.construct -> protein_construct, and where sequence_fields lives. migration/presets/molbio/2-to-3 must add oligo tables, replace preset copies, bump preset_versions. Check the zsqlab10 path only on a copy (spec/3-to-4 then molbio 2-to-3). No commit, leave the tree dirty.
done_when: Ticket 27 Verify passes: tm init --preset molbio gives the same kinds as v2 plus entity_oligo and stock_oligo_stock, tm check clean, preset_versions lists molbio 3 plus each part; [molbio, cellbio] loads once ticket 28 exists (until then the test-only preset with cell_culture); a molbio-v2 fixture with data migrates to v3 keeping every row and tm check clean.

blocks.title: review and merge ticket 27
blocks.doc: Lead: review diff against ticket and design, verify no table or kind rename slipped in, run the full suite, then commit on wave10/t27 and merge into main. Record the two open choices the agent made and whether they match the preferred options.
done_when: Diff reviewed; no unintended renames; full suite green; open choices recorded; branch committed and merged to main.

blocks.title: implement ticket 28 in worktree w28
blocks.doc: Read docs/tickets/28-cellbio-bundle.md and docs/preset-parts.md sections 2 and 2.1. Work only in the worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w28 (branch wave10/t28, own .venv). First check what the loader does with an entity_kinds entry that is not loaded, then take the smallest option, preferring the split cell_biosample/animal_biosample with no core change; record the choice in the part description and presets/README.md. No commit, leave the tree dirty.
done_when: Ticket 28 Verify passes: tm init --preset cellbio creates the expected tables and passes tm check; tm lineage <virus> shows no payload edge while <cell_line> shows parental; presets [molbio, cellbio] loads with shared parts loaded once and tm check clean; a biosample from a cell vial aliquot appears under it in tm lineage.

blocks.title: review and merge ticket 28
blocks.doc: Lead: review the diff, confirm the entity_kinds choice is the smallest one and is documented, run the full suite, then commit on wave10/t28 and merge into main.
done_when: Diff reviewed; entity_kinds choice documented and minimal; full suite green; branch committed and merged to main.

blocks.title: implement ticket 29 in worktree w29
blocks.doc: Read docs/tickets/29-angenet-bundle.md and docs/preset-parts.md section 3. Work only in the worktree .dsh/gitworktree/w29 (branch wave10/t29, own .venv). Adapt biosamples to ticket 28's choice. No core change: if one turns out necessary, stop and report instead of adding it. Document the litter recipe with exact tm commands in presets/README.md and skills/tetramark/SKILL.md. No commit, leave the tree dirty.
done_when: Ticket 29 Verify passes through the CLI: tm init --preset angenet passes tm check; the mouse strain -> cohort -> litter -> genotyping split chain works with dam/sire refs and tm lineage up/down reaches both parents; alive -> euthanized allowed, euthanized -> alive refused without --force; fly cross vial with a virgins aliquot; worm_cryo stored -> thawed then refused; v_stock_mouse_cohort drops aliquots_in_stock as mice are euthanized.

blocks.title: review and merge ticket 29
blocks.doc: Lead: review the diff, check no core change was needed, run the full suite, then commit on wave10/t29 and merge into main.
done_when: Diff reviewed; no core change; full suite green; branch committed and merged to main.

blocks.title: wave 10 acceptance on main
blocks.doc: Lead: on main after all five merges, run the full suite, tm init for molbio, cellbio, angenet and [molbio, cellbio] and tm check each; confirm docs/spec.md, README and skills/tetramark/SKILL.md match the shipped behaviour and migration/README explains the preset parts.
done_when: Full suite green on main; the four tm init combinations pass tm check; docs and skill agree with the code; no leftover temporary files or half-applied migrations in the repo.

blocks.title: release 0.3.0 and wave 10 handover
blocks.doc: Lead: bump the version, write docs/tickets/HANDOVER-wave11.md (or a wave 10 closing note), commit plans/ and the wave, push nothing unless asked.
done_when: Version bumped and committed with the wave 10 merge; handover names what shipped, the open choices made, and the zsqlab10 follow-up as a proposal only.

blocks.title: close git-bug 0a9acec and ask about zsqlab10
blocks.doc: Needs the user: close git-bug 0a9acec with a pointer to the release, and decide whether to run spec/3-to-4 plus molbio 2-to-3 on the real zsqlab10 ledger (proposal only until the user agrees).
done_when: git-bug 0a9acec closed with the release pointer, and the user has answered the zsqlab10 follow-up question.
